title: Disguise (Mechanic)

{{Hatnote|This article is about the [[Added Effect]] in {{BotW}} and {{TotK}}. For the [[Clothing]] in {{EoW}}, see [[Disguise]].}} {{Infobox Mechanic |image= {{Media |Screenshot BotW= [[File:BotW Disguise (Mechanic).png|320x320px]] |Screenshot TotK= [[File:TotK Disguise (Mechanic).png|320x320px]] }} |caption= |pronunciation= |game= BotW, TotK |other= |purpose= |related= {{List| * [[Added Effect]] * [[Armor]] * [[Stealth]] }} }} {{Term/Store|Disguise|Disguises|Series, BotW, TotK|plural}} are recurring mechanics in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Exp Game|BotW, TotK}}{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 280}}{{Cite Guide|TotK Piggyback|page=402-403}} ==Overview== Disguises are used by [[Link]] to avoid detection among [[Enemy|Enemies]] or hide his identity, allowing him to avoid combat or enter areas that he would not be allowed in otherwise. ==={{BotW|-}}=== In {{BotW}}, [[Link]] can wear a variety of [[Armor]]s to Disguise himself. By wearing the full [[Gerudo Outfit]], he can enter [[Gerudo Town]] without being thrown out. Once he obtains the [[Thunder Helm]], the [[Sand Boots]], or the [[Snow Boots]], he can wear them in place of the [[Gerudo Veil]] and [[Gerudo Sirwal]] while maintaining the effects of the Disguise. Link can also wear Armor with a Disguise [[Added Effect]] or [[Set Bonus]] to remain hidden among different types of [[Enemy|Enemies]], preventing them from attacking him unless he attacks them first. Enemies affected by Link's Disguise will follow him around and study him, making it difficult to perform [[Sneakstrike]]s on them. If an Enemy that is not affected by Link's Disguise begins to attack him, Enemies that were fooled by the Disguise will see through it and attack him as well. While using certain Disguise Effects, Link adopts a new idle pose to mimic the Enemy he is disguised as. {{Data Table |game= BotW |sortable= false |columns= Disguise Name[Nowrap], Armor[Nowrap], Description[Description] |- | Bokoblin Disguise{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 281}} | [[Bokoblin Mask]] | Disguises Link among [[Bokoblin]]s and [[Stalkoblin]]s. |- | Lizalfos Disguise | [[Lizalfos Mask]] | Disguises Link among [[Lizalfos]] and [[Stalizalfos]]. |- | Lynel Disguise | [[Lynel Mask]] | Temporarily disguises Link among [[Lynel]]s. They will attack Link after a short time, or sooner if he shows aggression, such as by swinging a [[Weapon]] or using the [[Camera]]. |- | Moblin Disguise | [[Moblin Mask]] | Disguises Link among [[Moblins]] and [[Stalmoblins]]. |- | Disguise | [[Majora's Mask (Item)|Majora's Mask]] | Combines the Disguise Effects of the [[Bokoblin Mask]], [[Moblin Mask]], [[Lizalfos Mask]], and [[Lynel Mask]]. |- | Stal Disguise{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|quote= Phantom Ganon set (Stealth Up, Stal Disguise, Bone Atk. Up)|page= 447}} | [[Radiant Attire]] (★★)
[[Phantom Ganon Set]] | Disguises Link among Stalkoblins, Stalmoblins, and Stalizalfos, and temporarily disguises Link among [[Stalnox]]es. }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== Much like in {{BotW}}, [[Link]] can wear different [[Armor]]s to disguise himself. The [[Gerudo Outfit]] is no longer available, but Link can now obtain and wear the [[Yiga Clan Attire]] to infiltrate the [[Yiga Clan Hideout]] and other strongholds of the [[Yiga Clan]]. Once he obtains the [[Lightning Helm]], Link can use it in place of the [[Yiga Mask]] without revealing his identity. Many friendly characters will chide Link's poor taste if he wears the Yiga Mask around them, and wearing it within [[Gerudo Town]] will result in Link being locked up in the local [[Jail]] until he takes it off.{{Cite|Thief! Seize him!|N/A|TotK}}{{Cite|Wait... Now that I look closely... You're the voe from before! Do you realize you're dressed like a member of a group that intends us harm? You'd put fear into many people here if you went around dressed like that, even though we know you aren't one of them. So if you want out of there, you'll need to change your clothes first!|Katta|TotK}} [[Yiga Footsoldier]]s and [[Yiga Blademaster]]s will not immediately attack Link while he is wearing this Disguise, but [[Master Kohga]] is not fooled by it.{{Cite|Yes, I know it's you, even under the mask!|Master Kohga|TotK}}{{Cite|Huh?! It's YOU again. You can't fool me, looking like that.|Master Kohga|TotK}}{{Cite|Yes, I know it's you, Link, mask and all.|Master Kohga|TotK}}{{Cite|I've been waiting for you. Your disguises will do you no good, Link.|Master Kohga|TotK}} Link can wear [[Armor]] with a Disguise [[Added Effect]] or [[Set Bonus]] to prevent certain types of [[Enemy|Enemies]] from attacking him. Disguise Effects will end early if Link attacks an Enemy, or if an Enemy not fooled by the Disguise starts to attack Link. In addition to the special idle poses available in {{BotW|-}}, Link has a new idle pose while wearing the [[Horriblin Mask]]. {{Data Table |game= TotK |sortable= false |columns= Armor[Nowrap], Description[Description] |- | [[Bokoblin Mask]] | Disguises Link among [[Bokoblin]]s and [[Stalkoblin]]s. |- | [[Horriblin Mask]] | Disguises Link among [[Horriblin]]s. |- | [[Lizalfos Mask]] | Disguises Link among [[Lizalfos]] and [[Stalizalfos]]. |- | [[Lynel Mask]] | Temporarily disguises Link among [[Lynel]]s. They will attack Link after a short time, or sooner if he shows aggression, such as by swinging a [[Weapon]] or using the [[Camera]]. |- | [[Moblin Mask]] | Disguises Link among [[Moblins]] and [[Stalmoblins]]. |- | [[Majora's Mask (Item)|Majora's Mask]] | Combines the Disguise Effects of the [[Bokoblin Mask]], [[Horriblin Mask]], [[Moblin Mask]], [[Lizalfos Mask]], and [[Lynel Mask]]. |- | [[Radiant Attire]] (★★)
